mapper.sql: a.id, a.parcel_id, a.grantor_id, a.grantee_id, a.auth_code, a.status, a.expire_at, a.remark, a.created_at, a.used_at, a.revoked_at, p.tracking_no, p.courier_company, p.status AS parcel_status, s.name AS station_name, sh.code AS shelf_code, g.real_name AS grantor_name, g.username AS grantor_username, e.real_name AS grantee_name, e.username AS grantee_username

FROM proxy_auth a JOIN parcel p ON p.id = a.parcel_id JOIN station s ON s.id = p.station_id LEFT JOIN shelf sh ON sh.id = p.shelf_id JOIN sys_user g ON g.id = a.grantor_id JOIN sys_user e ON e.id = a.grantee_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO proxy_auth (parcel_id, grantor_id, grantee_id, auth_code, status, expire_at, remark) VALUES (#{parcelId}, #{grantorId}, #{granteeId}, #{authCode}, 'ACTIVE', #{expireAt}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM proxy_auth WHERE parcel_id = #{parcelId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE proxy_auth SET status = 'USED', used_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_at > now()
UPDATE proxy_auth SET status = 'REVOKED', revoked_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND grantor_id = #{grantorId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: UPDATE proxy_auth SET status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND expire_at <= now() RETURNING *
SELECT count(*) FROM proxy_auth WHERE status = #{status}
